sources.finding: Official Qwen3.5-4B describes a 4B language model with a Vision Encoder, hidden dimension 2560 and native multimodal use.
sources.architecture_effect: Confirms the target family already includes deep vision; second heavy semantic visual stack is not automatically justified.

sources.finding: Exact current 4B config has text hidden_size 2560; vision depth 24, hidden_size 1024, out_hidden_size 2560, patch_size 16, spatial_merge_size 2, temporal_patch_size 2, deepstack_visual_indexes empty; text uses interleaved M-RoPE parameters.
sources.architecture_effect: Use exact 4B config rather than generic library defaults; projected visual output matches language input dimension; no 4B DeepStack tap is required for the first baseline.

sources.finding: Current image preprocessing uses patch_size 16, temporal_patch_size 2 and merge_size 2 with dynamic sizing.
sources.architecture_effect: Preprocessor identity and token-budget policy are causal feature-epoch inputs.

sources.finding: Official safetensors metadata reports total_size 9,319,737,856 bytes while the model card labels the language model as 4B.
sources.architecture_effect: Resource accounting must use complete deployed text+vision artifacts/runtime footprint rather than nominal language-model parameter label.

sources.finding: mtmd_get_output_embd/mtmd_batch_get_output_embd expose output float embeddings sized llama_model_n_embd_inp(model) times media-token count; mtmd APIs include experimental surfaces and batch/context ownership constraints.
sources.architecture_effect: Provides a concrete projected visual-token buffer for MVC-Q0 without a second encode; runtime version must be provenance-bound.

sources.finding: Current server process_mtmd_chunk obtains embd via mtmd_batch_get_output_embd and immediately passes the same pointer to mtmd_helper_decode_image_chunk after mtmd_batch_encode.
sources.architecture_effect: Identifies the minimal pre-decode hook for shared-buffer MVC gating.

sources.finding: Qwen's dedicated multimodal embedding family uses explicit embedding architecture/training and extracts a final semantic representation for retrieval rather than treating a base generative VLM buffer as automatically calibrated embedding space.
sources.architecture_effect: Keeps the strongest counterhypothesis alive: raw projected Qwen3.5 visual tokens may need a tiny trained projection or dedicated lightweight baseline for open-set calibration.

sources.finding: A closed Qwen3.5 issue documented image correctness depending on batch/ubatch settings in larger variants.
sources.architecture_effect: Treat batch/ubatch as mandatory target-regression metadata; do not infer the exact 4B target is affected until reproduced.

sources.finding: A closed issue documented a Qwen3.5 vision-projector CUDA/Flash-Attention CPU fallback with roughly order-of-magnitude image-encode regression on that build/hardware.
sources.architecture_effect: Backend/runtime commit enters resource receipts and FeatureEpoch until invariance/performance are demonstrated.

sources.finding: A closed-as-not-planned report observed very slow MTMD image encoding in llama-server versus CLI for Qwen3.5-9B on one setup.
sources.architecture_effect: Benchmark the exact server path, not only CLI or theoretical vision cost.

sources.finding: A recent Qwen3.5 multimodal issue reports M-RoPE/CUDA illegal-memory-access sensitivity to attention/cache/prompt-order conditions on a larger variant.
sources.architecture_effect: Adds image-first vs long-text-before-image and runtime configuration to exact 4B acceptance regression matrix; no transfer claim without reproduction.

sources.finding: Historical GUI screenshot study reports that background/spatial structure can carry transition information and that aggressive semantic pruning can discard useful context; recency-weighted compression is useful.
sources.architecture_effect: ROI-only is not sufficient as a default claim; retain full-frame structural anchor evidence and compare ROI vs ROI+context.

sources.finding: GUIPruner reports benefits from temporal-adaptive resolution plus structure-aware pruning while preserving global layout.
sources.architecture_effect: Supports a global-low-detail + local-high-detail experiment rather than blind changed-region cropping.

sources.finding: Failure-mode study reports full-image visual memory can worsen action-level/grounding failures and proposes action-grounded local visual memory.
sources.architecture_effect: Strengthens QNDRF action/outcome-linked crop memory as a candidate but requires Frank-specific matched tests.

sources.finding: ReVision reports temporal screenshot redundancy reduction can cut visual-token usage while preserving/improving benchmark performance in its setting.
sources.architecture_effect: Supports testing temporal redundancy suppression, but deterministic tile/hash gating remains the cheaper Frank baseline.

counterevidence_policy: Issue reports and external papers are transfer-risk evidence only until reproduced on the exact Frank 4B target; no architecture promotion from source count or benchmark rank.
